name: Meta Debug & Self-Explanation
description: Explain the assistant or system's previous behavior from the current conversation and runtime context.

en: Why did you answer like that just now?
Why did the plan card not show up?
Why was your previous answer so short?
zh: 你刚刚为什么那样回答？
为什么会出现 fallback 文案？
为什么 plan card 没显示出来？
你刚才的回复为什么那么短？
